listing.name: Voidfaring Hubship - Upgradeble Ship Start
listing.summary: Adds custom start with custom version of Djoeng Voidfaring Hubship from Indies Expansion. Upgrade ship with array of upgrades to return it to shape and push it beyond all reason.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a customizable ship start featuring an upgradeable hubship with modular components and swappable systems.

description:
Custom start available in vanilla or with Nexerelin . There minor differences between two, but they not gameplay significant.

MOD DOES NOT REQUIRE INDIES EXPANSION, MOST RELEVANT THINGS BEEN RECREATED FROM SCRATCH, BUT THAT MEANS MOD'S HUBSHIP DOES NOT DIRECTLY LINKED WITH INDIES EXPANSION SYSTEMS.

Want to add mod to existing save? You in luck, because it also works! Just need to grab it with Console Commands! I highly recommend d-moded version for full experience (and credit's draining).

Full command for d-moded version:

addShip JHS_junkhubship_core_Start_D

Just copy and paste it in Console panel and enjoy you own Grand Chungus.

Upgrades, people, upgrades, that's what it all about. Do you like supercaps? Want start with one, but earn its power? Like The Infernal Machine start? Think there not enough "upgrade your ship" starts? Or just want Djoeng Hubship from Indies Expansion without all instability on 0.98? In any case this mod likely for you.

So what it all about?

- Adds custom start with custom version of Djoeng Voidfaring Hubship from Indies Expansion.
- Upgrade ship with array of upgrades to return it to shape and push it beyond all reason.
- Advanced upgrades include 2 permanent improvements, 2 swappable upgrades focused either on weapons or on fighter bays, 3 swappable variants of module configurations (including starting one)
- 3 swappable systems as ultimate option (including base Burn Drive) after unlocking everything else.
- Some additional buffs for modules not listed as direct upgrades.

Notable differences of my Hubship version from Indies Expansion's Djoeng:

- More DP cost (70 => 80);
- More HP (10000 => 12000);
- No crazy amount of OP on shield module (140 => 50);
- Modules always detach when destroyed (not sure how relevant it was for original, but now it happens for sure);
- Module rendering order was changed, and I added underlying structure to the sprite, so ship without modules still looks sturdy.
- Hubship uses 4 Big Mook and 1 War mook drone launchers, removing Watchtower drone launchers.
- Drone ships hubship launches not available in any other way, and use vanilla weapons.
- Left module counts as having wings by default, so it affects which hullmods it can use.

Additional features:

- New sprite of my vision (still WIP, but you can use it with Magiclib's Paintjob menu)
- You can restart your upgrade journey if you lost ship, but don't want to/don't have previous save available with additional failsafe option (outside the start, ship only acquirable with console commands).

Planned features:

- Bounty with fully fitted combat focused ship with support fleet to acquire ship if you don't start with it.
- Finished alternative sprite.

Credits:
- NeoLemon/Combustible Lemon for full permission to mess with their stuff.
- Dark Revenant for permission to use Underworld upgrade system code.
- Kirbo and toopok4k3 for help with new sprite in ideas and work.
- hunterkiller725 as person who initially commissioned mod, and get me to work.
- TS360 / Hugh 359 special thanks for initial popularization of the mod!
- rareWhale, Halfarel, BloodyChimp for testing and ideas

P.S.: Some sprites used by Indies expansion part of Spiral arms, but I have no way of knowing which ones, so leave it here as part of credits.
For additional credits connected to original Indies Expansion see its forum page: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=28377.0

Changelog

Spoiler
v1.1c (17/08/2026) - Paintjob fix

Changes:
- Changed ship files to allow paintjob to be inherited from base hull.
- As side effect of it Autofits will be saved between upgrades.

v1.1b (05/08/2026)

- Fixed typo in Heavy Weapons Integration hullmod
- Fixed upgrades for modules saying 6 fighter bays instead of 5.
- Added some missing descriptions.

v1.1a (05/08/2026)

Hubship got mini rework based on some feedback:
- Most weapons get slightly different, mostly improved arcs.
- Large Hardpoint been turned into the Large Turret (preserving mount types) and getting much more generous arc.
- Heavy Ballistics integration got replaced by Heavy Weapons Integration, reducing OP cost of energy and ballistic large weapons
- Side modules now use Offense Focus as a ship systems (Mix of AAF and HEF)
- 2 medium turrets on each side module are now hybrid
- Modules now have maximum of 5 wing bays instead of 6

Other Hubship changes:
- Original sprite got more polish, most notable being new bays, and using some of engines which were created for the paintjob.
- Also oriented most mounts according with their arcs
- Hubship now use MK1 style engines instead of mix of high tech and low tech.
- Painjob finally got tweaks created by ¥6G added (no more black holes in paintjob, and thanks again!)
- Wanderer now shouldn't count mothballed ships for its effect.
- Offense Focus fire rate effect reduced to 70% from 80%

Also
- Added Version Checker support

Bugfixes
- Made Fleet Gantry apply effects right, again. Unfortunately means DP reduction from hullmod is non accounted for by Fleet by DP mod, again.

v1.0b  - The bugfix update
Bugfixes:
Fixed Nexerelin Start not working at all.
Fixed "Fleet Gantry - Collapsed" suffering same bug for Fleet by DP
Fixed "Wanderer" Logistics Overhaul providing effect with 7 ship in fleet instead of 5.
Changes:
Hubship max speed increased (20 => 25)
Hubship max turn speed increased (4 => 6)
Mod's source code now on GitHub too.

v1.0a - The "bugfix" update
Bugfixes:
Fixed Fleet Gantry bonus not counting for Fleet by DP mod.
Fixed Fleet Gantry not applying burn level bonus.
Fixed Hubship having lower than intended DP and S/R (75 > 80)
Remove Onslaught from ship_data.csv

Changes:
Added ability to start with Hubship without Nexerelin. In this case Hubship comes with fixed d-mods opposed to random ones in Nexerelin start.
Done minor rewamp of original Indies Expansion sprite. Paintjob without changes in this update.
Redid descriptions for Fleet Gantry and Fleet Gantry - Collapsed
Fleet Gantry now provides bonus to fleet Sustained Burn of 2 (to make overall speed the same with Sustained Burn as before the change.
"Wanderer" Logistics Overhaul lost is bonus to burn level.
"Wanderer" Logistics Overhaul received reduction to ship fuel consumption of 30%.
"Wanderer" Logistics Overhaul reduction to ship monthly supply consumption of reduced from 50% to 40%.
[Modules] Combat configuration and [Modules] Logistic configuration now have proper descriptions of their effects.
Unstable Shield now uses Degraded Shield icon.
Tweaked Voidfaring Hubship Command description to mention that it coordinates wings on modules.
Mod got new icon for TriOS.

v0.9c - Crash hotfix
- Fixed crash due to left over stuff in config (I should stop testing stuff in mine active mods)
- Changed version in mod_info to 0.9c

v0.9b - Minor text fixes
- Fixed error in rules value for weapon upgrades
- Fixed attemp to attach ship's name to notification of weapons/wing removal by upgrades.
